reviews.author: Aarav Patel
reviews.comment: Finally authentic Bombay style Chinese in Hounslow! The Manchow soup with crispy noodles and Chicken Lollipop taste exactly like Mumbai roadside stalls.

reviews.author: Priya Sharma
reviews.comment: The Triple Combo is unreal! Generous portion of Schezwan rice and noodles with rich gravy. Will definitely be ordering weekly.

reviews.author: Rohan Mehta
reviews.comment: Bombay Chilli Dumplings and Masala Chips are top tier. Wok flavor is genuine, quick service and 100% Halal.

reviews.author: Aisha Khan
reviews.comment: Hosted our family get-together in the VIP dining section. The Schezwan Fried Rice, Dragon Chicken, and Veg Momos blew everyone away.

reviews.author: Marcus Davies
reviews.comment: Best Indo-Chinese restaurant in West London without a doubt. The wok hei (breath of the wok) in their Hakka Noodles is absolute perfection.

reviews.author: Sneha Kulkarni
reviews.comment: Brought me straight back to Bombay’s Khau Galli! The Paneer Chilli Dry and Hot & Sour Soup have that exact spicy-tangy street kick.

reviews.author: David Sterling
reviews.comment: The burnt garlic fried rice paired with Manchurian gravy is sensational. Spotless dining room, attentive waitstaff, and fast turnaround.

reviews.author: Zainab Begum
reviews.comment: Loved that everything is 100% Halal certified! Crispy Thread Paneer and Bombay Chilli Prawns are must-tries for any seafood lover.

reviews.author: Vikram Singhania
reviews.comment: Booked their banquet hall for a corporate dinner of 25 people. Flawless service, personalized set menu, and every single dish arrived piping hot.

reviews.author: Chloe Bennett
reviews.comment: Such vibrant flavours! The Sweet Corn Chicken Soup was comforting and the Schezwan Chicken Momos were juicy, plump, and deeply flavorful.

reviews.author: Rajesh Joshi
reviews.comment: As a strict vegetarian from Mumbai, their Jain & Vegetarian options are unmatched. Veg Manchurian and Triple Schezwan Rice made my weekend.

reviews.author: Fatima Al-Mansoor
reviews.comment: The ambience is gorgeous with modern Bombay aesthetics. Chicken Lollipop with their signature fiery Schezwan dip is addictive.

reviews.author: Liam O’Connor
reviews.comment: Massive portions and incredible value for money. The Singapore Noodles and Crispy Salt & Pepper Squid were five stars.

reviews.author: Ananya Deshmukh
reviews.comment: We travel 45 minutes just to eat their Bombay Street Style Chowmein and Crispy Corn Salt & Pepper. Truly unmissable dining spot.

reviews.author: Tariq Mahmood
reviews.comment: Superb service from Rohit and the team. The table ordering via POS with SMS invoice was ultra seamless and modern.

reviews.author: Natasha Ivanova
reviews.comment: First time trying Indo-Chinese cuisine and I am obsessed. The dumplings are so tender and the chilli garlic gravy is to die for.

reviews.author: Karan Malhotra
reviews.comment: The Schezwan Fried Rice has that genuine fiery red Bombay color and aroma without artificial taste. Top marks to the Mumbai head chefs.

reviews.author: Sophia Taylor
reviews.comment: Came for Sunday lunch with friends. Warm atmosphere, polite servers, and the mocktails pair great with spicy starters.

reviews.author: Devendra Verma
reviews.comment: Celebrated our 25th Wedding Anniversary here. Outstanding hospitality, custom seating arrangement, and exceptional banquet food.

reviews.author: Rehan Siddiqui
reviews.comment: The Wok-Tossed Chilli Chicken is crispy on the outside and juicy inside. Easily the top dining spot on Hounslow High Street.

reviews.author: Maya Sen
reviews.comment: Extra spicy Manchow soup cured my cold instantly! Crunchy fried noodles on top were fresh and delicious. Love this place!

reviews.author: James Wilson
reviews.comment: Great location near Treaty Centre. Clean tables, fast lunch specials, and the Bombay Masala Chips are legendary.

reviews.author: Simran Kaur
reviews.comment: Their Kurkure Momos and Chilli Garlic Noodles have set a new benchmark. Highly recommended for party bookings.

reviews.author: Harpreet Singh
reviews.comment: Outstanding food quality and generous portions. The spicy Szechuan gravy with steamed basmati rice is pure comfort food.

reviews.author: Emily Watson
reviews.comment: Staff was so welcoming and helped us choose dishes according to our mild spice preference. 10/10 dining experience.

settings.name: INDO CHINESE
settings.description: Born on the vibrant, bustling streets of Bombay, Indo-Chinese cuisine is a true celebration of two rich culinary worlds coming together. Where traditional Chinese stir-fry and wok techniques meet bold Indian spices.

menuItem.name: Manchow Soup (Chicken)
menuItem.description: Classic dark soya broth with shredded chicken breast, garlic, and fresh green chillies topped with crunchy fried noodles.

menuItem.name: TRIPLE COMBO (Rice and Noodles Mix and Gravy)
menuItem.description: The Ultimate Bombay Street Masterpiece: Fragrant Schezwan Fried Rice and Hakka Noodles stir-fried together in high wok heat, served with rich Schezwan Gravy, Fried Egg / Paneer, and crispy fried noodles.
